title: GAFC Safety Pop Quiz: Finger Discipline!
body:
🚨🧠 🚨🧠 Pop Quiz, GAFC Fam! Gloxsie 21 and Bobo Licious are dropping some knowledge, GAFC style!

Bobo Licious, bless his heart, sometimes gets a little too comfortable. Gloxsie just caught him handling a firearm, talking smack, with his finger chilling RIGHT ON the trigger. You know that ain't it, right?

What's the FIRST gun safety principle Gloxsie 21 is about to remind Bobo to keep our communities safe and strong, echoing the wisdom we share even at Church of Legacy?

A) Always treat every firearm as if it's loaded.
B) Clear that weapon before you even think about handling it!
C) Yo, your finger stays OFF the trigger until your sights are on target, no exceptions!
D) You sure you want to redecorate with that muzzle, Bobo?

Vote below! Let's show Bobo (and each other) that street smarts also mean gun smarts. Your knowledge protects our legacy. Stay sharp, stay safe! 🕊️
